test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north. T is sitting to the immediate left of S. Only two people are sitting to the left of P. Only two people are sitting between P and S. T is third to the left of the person sitting at the extreme right end. How many people are sitting in the row?
solution: **Given: **A certain number of people are sitting in a straight line facing north. **Solution: ** (1) T is sitting to the immediate left of S. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7407a69699f7c0ab68024489f3d63c2eb7b4184ad83707704a580bb3f136771c.png] (2) Only two people are sitting between P and S.
